package.welcome_message: Welcome to your 3-day Amman adventure, curated with authentic Jordanian experiences and local expertise.

trip.title: Amman Highlights & Heritage
trip.summary: Three days of cultural immersion in Amman, featuring historic sites, rooftop dining, and local guides. Each day stays within the city, with outdoor visits in the cooler mornings and relaxed afternoons.

planning.strategy: Each day stays in one area: Amman (3 days). Walk heritage and nature in the morning. Save museums, meals, and shade for the afternoon. About 2 places to visit and 2 meals each day.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.
